flow_steps.description: User logs in manually — fill ARN, captcha, OTP, click Continue

actions.description: Complete login manually — fill ARN 136539, captcha, click Continue, enter OTP 11223, click Continue again
actions.instructions: Fill ARN: 136539, fill captcha, click Continue, enter OTP: 11223, click Continue. The scanner resumes once you reach the dashboard.

flow_steps.description: Explore all reachable post-login screens — dashboard, reports, transactions, settings

actions.description: Explore all authenticated Pragati routes including dashboard, reports, transactions, investor details, and settings

exploration_profile.persona: Behave like a mutual fund distributor using the Pragati platform. Explore the main dashboard, investor list, transactions, SIP management, reports, AMC tools, and any settings/profile pages.
journey_rules: After reaching the dashboard, explore main navigation items before going into sub-pages.
If a list of investors or transactions is visible, open at least one detail view.
Explore reports and analytics sections to cover charts, tables, and export features.
